reason: Instagram already fills my Friday and Saturday nights and it costs me nothing. Free listing is fine, I would not mind them loading my flyers, but I am not paying for something that has no audience yet.
objection: Why pay when Instagram already works and is free? I have never heard of this app and nobody in my area uses it, so I cannot see who would actually see my nights.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing the app past 2,000 active users in my city, and proof from a venue like mine that it brought people in the door on a Friday that Instagram did not.
